units.source_text: 现在千重子回想起这样一件事来：

en.t: Now Chieko remembered something like this:

units.source_text: 今年春上郁金香盛开的时候，从植物园回家途中，在加茂川堤岸上，

en.t: This spring, when the tulips were in full bloom, on the way home from the botanical garden, on the bank of the Kamo River,

units.source_text: 父亲曾劝母亲把秀男招为自己的入赘女婿。

en.t: her father had once urged her mother to take Hideo in as their adopted son-in-law.
